notes: Twelve real mouse down/move/up sequences per theme; 14px rightward movement stays within the same folder button.
The native swipe recognizer starts at 10px and suppresses click after claimed movement even when the 48px back threshold is not reached.
Geometry-read counts measure scrollWidth/clientWidth accesses in swipeBackNativeGestureOwner, not forced layout counts.
Tab deliberate swipe uses a temporary button probe inside a real SearchView tab surface.
Mac wheel events are synthetic; the normal mouse sequences are Playwright mouse input.
No native Obsidian, iOS, Android or WebKit verification.
